"FIFA 17 STICKMAN – COMPLETE EDITION

Create FIFA 17 STICKMAN, a complete recreation of FIFA 17 featuring detailed Stickman graphics, smooth animations, realistic stadiums, professional gameplay, official FIFA-style intro, cinematic opening, complete main menu, music, sound effects and professional commentary.

GAME MODES: Manager Career Mode, Player Career Mode, Ultimate Team, Tournaments, Friendlies, Seasons, Training, Domestic Cups, Copa Libertadores, UEFA Champions League and UEFA Europa League.

TEAMS AND NATIONAL TEAMS: Include all available official clubs, major European leagues, Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Brazilian Championship Series A, B and C, Brazilian clubs, national teams from every country and Brazil National Team.

FULL SQUADS: Include players, starters, substitutes, goalkeepers, star players, attributes, positions, shirt numbers and kits, with updated squads.

CUSTOMIZATION: Official club crests, kits, boots, stadiums, edit players, create players, create teams, transfers, edit lineups and tactics.

GAMEPLAY: Fully playable offline matches against CPU, local two-player mode, play with any club or national team, free kicks, penalties, cards, substitutions, celebrations, replays, multiple camera angles, dynamic weather and animated crowds.

Include complete menus in English, Portuguese and Spanish, multiple commentary languages, team lineups, scoreboard, radar, instant replays and a FIFA 17-style interface. All menus, buttons and game modes must work correctly. Deliver a complete, polished and playable Stickman football game.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.

- Build a complete, polished, playable stickman football game inspired by FIFA 17.

- Built as a dependency-free single-page web game.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, polished, playable stickman football game inspired by FIFA 17.

## Requirements
- Include match modes, team selection, career-style sections, Ultimate Team, tournaments, seasons, training, local play, and friendlies.
- Support English, Portuguese, and Spanish menus.
- Include playable football with CPU, passing, shooting, scoring, pause, and mobile controls.
- Use responsive menus and a FIFA-style presentation.

## Decisions
- Keep the game as a dependency-free, single-page web app.
- Use a canvas-based 2D pitch.
- Provide representative clubs and national teams rather than licensed rosters.
- Use separate landing/setup screens for expanded modes rather than fully persistent career or season systems.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the complete interface in `index.html`.
- Implemented home, play modes, match setup, squads, customization, and settings screens.
- Implemented match play, CPU AI, passing, shooting, scoring, match clock, pause, and quit.
- Added desktop and mobile controls.
- Added English, Portuguese, and Spanish language switching.
- Verified the home and live-match pages load through the local server.
- Captured `screenshots/home.jpg` and `screenshots/match.jpg`.
- Verified the embedded JavaScript syntax with a script extraction and `node --check`.
- Confirmed the server at `http://localhost:3002` serves the game with HTTP 200.
- Captured a final 1280×720 browser screenshot at `/tmp/final-home.jpg`.

### Active
- Final interaction testing of navigation and match flow.
- Final verification of local two-player movement and pass/shoot controls.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload the game and test Kick Off through a live match.
2. Verify local two-player movement, passing, and shooting.
3. Test navigation and language switching across all pages.
4. Capture a final JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `[index.html]`: Complete game interface and implementation.
- `[screenshots/home.jpg]`: Verified home-page screenshot.
- `[screenshots/match.jpg]`: Verified live-match screenshot.

## Important Context
- The game is available at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Desktop controls are WASD, Q, Space, Shift, Arrow Keys, and Esc.
- Local two-player behavior uses Arrow Keys for Player 2, E to pass, and Shift to shoot.
- The implementation uses no licensed FIFA branding, assets, or player databases.

## Objective
- Complete and polish the FIFA 17-inspired stickman football web game.

## Requirements
- Maintain a dependency-free, responsive, single-page canvas game.
- Include match modes, team selection, career-style sections, Ultimate Team, tournaments, seasons, training, local play, and friendlies.
- Support English, Portuguese, and Spanish menus.
- Provide CPU/local play, passing, shooting, scoring, pause, quit, and mobile controls.

## Decisions
- Keep the app as one `index.html` with no licensed branding or rosters.
- Use representative clubs and national teams.
- Keep expanded modes as landing/setup screens rather than persistent career or season systems.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the complete interface and gameplay implementation.
- Added home, setup, squads, customization, settings, and expanded mode screens.
- Added CPU AI, match clock, scoring, pause, quit, passing, shooting, and both control schemes.
- Verified the server and JavaScript syntax.
- Captured home and match screenshots.
- Verified `http://localhost:3002` returns HTTP 200.
- Verified Kick Off navigation reaches match setup and local two-player mode selects correctly.
- Verified a live match launches from setup with a functioning canvas and match clock.
- Verified P2 movement and pass/shoot key handling in a live local match.
- Captured `/tmp/stickman-check.jpg` and `/tmp/stickman-final-match.png`.

### Active
- Final verification of navigation and language switching across all pages.
- Final desktop/mobile presentation check.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Complete navigation testing across all mode, squad, customize, and settings pages.
2. Verify English, Portuguese, and Spanish switching in a clean page state.
3. Complete local two-player control verification for WASD, Arrow Keys, pass, and shoot.
4. Capture a final JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `[index.html]`: Complete interface and game implementation.
- `[screenshots/home.jpg]`: Verified home-page screenshot.
- `[screenshots/match.jpg]`: Verified live-match screenshot.
- `/tmp/stickman-final-match.png`: Final 1280×720 local-match verification screenshot.
- `/tmp/stickman-check.jpg`: Final 1280×720 browser screenshot.

## Important Context
- The game is available at `http://localhost:3002`.
- P1 uses WASD, Q to pass, Space/Enter to shoot, and Shift to sprint.
- P2 in local mode uses Arrow Keys to move, E to pass, and Shift to shoot.
- Mobile controls expose left/right movement plus pass and shoot buttons.
- The app uses no licensed FIFA branding, assets, or player databases.
